subject.title: sessions.create worktreeBaseRef reaches git worktree add without a -- separator, allowing git flag injection

question: Should this valid but currently unreleased operator-triggered argument-injection bug be fixed through private security handling before the managed-worktree feature ships?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but the report is publicly disclosed and security-labeled, so maintainers must choose the disclosure and landing path rather than ClawSweeper automatically staging a patch.

options.title: Fix privately before release
options.body: Move detailed handling to the security process, land the narrow separator and regression-test fix, and avoid amplifying the public reproduction.

options.title: Treat as public hardening
options.body: Keep the issue public, explicitly scope it to trusted-operator cleanup denial, and land the same focused fix through ordinary review.

recommendation.title: Fix privately before release
recommendation.body: Move detailed handling to the security process, land the narrow separator and regression-test fix, and avoid amplifying the public reproduction.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently expanded the managed-worktree and session base-ref behavior, making him the strongest available owner for the pre-release handling choice.
